space.floor_area.doc: Walkable floor area (floor faces with at least 1 m of headroom).

space.headroom.doc: Clear height above the floor (open-sky floor excluded).

space.open_sky_fraction.doc: Share of the floor with no ceiling within 200 m.

space.clear_width.doc: Narrowest horizontal span through each floor point, at chest height.

corridor.width.doc: Clear width of corridors (spaces at most 8 m wide and at least 2.5 times as long).

corridor.fraction.doc: Share of the floor area that is corridor.

opening.width.doc: Clear width of doorways and other narrowings between spaces.

opening.height.doc: Clear height (lintel) of doorways and other narrowings.

opening.count.doc: Number of detected doorways and narrowings.

vertical.span.doc: Height range of the walkable floor (p99 - p1).

vertical.layers.doc: Number of distinct floor levels (1 m bins holding at least 5% of the floor).

room.width.doc: Larger horizontal side of each room's bounding box.

room.depth.doc: Smaller horizontal side of each room's bounding box.

room.height.doc: Height of each room's bounding box.

room.volume.doc: Volume of each room's bounding box.

topology.rooms.doc: Main rooms (not sub-rooms or sky rooms).

topology.dead_ends.doc: Rooms with exactly one portal connection.

topology.loops.doc: Independent loops in the room graph (E - V + C).

topology.diameter.doc: Longest shortest room-to-room path in the largest group.

textures.count.doc: Distinct textures on the compiled faces.

texel.tile_metres.doc: World size of one texture repeat (area-weighted).

detail.area_fraction.doc: Share of the face area that comes from detail brushes.

brush.air_fraction.doc: Share of brushes that are air.

lights.warm_fraction.doc: Share of lights with a warm hue (0-70 degrees).

lights.cool_fraction.doc: Share of lights with a cool hue (170-260 degrees).

lights.neutral_fraction.doc: Share of lights with little colour (saturation below 0.12).

lights.height_above_floor.doc: Light height above the floor below it.

spawns.nn_distance.doc: Distance from each respawn point to its nearest neighbour.

spawns.per_100m2.doc: Respawn points per 100 m2 of floor.

spawns.clear_width.doc: Clear width at each respawn point.

items.nn_distance.doc: Distance from each item to its nearest item.

items.to_nearest_spawn.doc: Distance from each item to the nearest respawn point.

items.height_above_floor.doc: Item height above the floor below it.
